content: lucide latest is 1.44.0 (npm registry). Official getting-started docs still document the UMD CDN global (script src=unpkg.com/lucide@latest exposes lucide.createIcons and lucide.icons) and explicitly recommend anchoring to an exact version instead of @latest. New @lucide/icons package (2026) ships tree-shakable icon data and dynamic-import maps for bundler users. For this no-build app the UMD global pattern (lucide.icons[name] in the Icon component) stays valid; pin lucide@1.44.0 or an exact 1.x. Verified unpkg lucide@1.44.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js returns 200 text/javascript.
